Average hydrogen-disordered P42/nmc H2O structure from the 293 K Hirshfeld-atom refinement of Chodkiewicz et al., IUCrJ 9, 573-579 (2022), doi:10.1107/S2052252522006662, keeping its fractional coordinates and c/a ratio; the lattice is scaled isotropically to the 300 K EOS V0.

## Bezacier et al. (2014), PVT BM2

`ice_vi_bezacier_2014_bm2_1` · Executable

Reproduction: **reproduced** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/ice_vi.md#record-ice_vi_bezacier_2014_bm2_1)

**Source check:** Coefficients from Table II with Equations (1)-(3) (p. 104505-4): BM2 with T0 = 300 K and exponential constant-alpha scaling of the reference volume.

- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Bezacier; Journaux; Perrillat; Cardon; Hanfland; Daniel
    - **Year:** 2014
    - **Title:** Equations of state of ice VI and ice VII at high pressure and high temperature
    - **Source:** Journal of Chemical Physics
    - **Volume:** 141
    - **Locator:** 104505
    - **DOI:** 10.1063/1.4894421
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[1.26, 2.81\]
- **Reported temperature coverage (K):** \[298.7, 340.7\]

P-V-T fit for pure H2O ice VI. Published molar V0 = 14.17(2) cm³/mol; stored per unit cell (Z = 10). dK/dT was fixed to zero because no temperature dependence was detectable.
